featured_reviews.name: Ankita Gawade
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently, I visited the Tanishq store at Linking Road, Santacruz (West), with my sister on her birthday, and we had a wonderful experience. We bought beautiful earrings for her, and the staff was extremely courteous, professional, and helpful. They showed us many elegant options and made our shopping experience smooth and enjoyable.
We were impressed by the diamond clarity checking machine, which reflected their commitment to quality. The staff also arranged a cake-cutting celebration for my sister’s birthday, making the visit even more special.

featured_reviews.name: PADMINI ASRANI
featured_reviews.review_text:
My daughter and I visited and purchased jewelry from Tanishq twice in the last 15 days during our visit to India.
The entire process from entering the showroom to completing the formalities of the transaction was efficient and seamless.
Staff very truly customer service oriented and knowledgeable about their inventory .
We exchanged gold for the purchase . That process was seamless too and fast unlike a very bad experience at a competitor's store.

Overall experience was very good. I would come back to this store in the future and recommend them highly.

featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent service by Manoj Soni. Very supportive, knowledgeable, and dedicated to ensuring a great customer experience. featured_reviews.review_text: The team at Tanishq has been wonderful, the time taken to take us through every aspect of the jewellery purchased - the machines, the clarity, the weight, the karat checks etc.. featured_reviews.name: Anita Rana
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience at Tanishq, thanks to the incredible service by Prabir Jana. Prabir helped clean and repair my jewelry with the utmost patience, grace, and professionalism. He handled each piece with great care and attention to detail, ensuring everything was restored beautifully. What truly stood out was his calm, respectful approach and willingness to take the time to do the job perfectly—never rushed, always focused on quality. It’s rare to find someone so dedicated to their craft and so committed to customer satisfaction. I greatly appreciate his help and would highly recommend Prabir Jana to anyone looking for expert jewelry care at Tanishq. Thank you for such a seamless and pleasant experience!

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an outstanding experience with Anmol Jewellers during a recent trip to Mumbai. Komal and Bhabika looked after us from start to finish, and they were exceptional. I needed two custom wedding bands, one ladies and one gents, as well as a diamond engagement ring. I arrived in Mumbai with the designs, and Anmol created all three pieces within about four weeks. The final result was exactly as drawn and even better than I expected.

They sourced a high quality diamond for the engagement ring at an excellent price. It was noticeably better in both price and quality than what we were shown elsewhere, including at Tashniq and Popley’s. The team were proactive and rang their suppliers while we were there so we could compare options on the spot. As a foreigner without an Indian card, I also appreciated that they happily accommodated a bank transfer as the payment method.

Komal and Bhabika were consistently kind, attentive and relaxed. They offered food and drinks, took their time with us, and never pushed for a sale. That was a real contrast to some of the other stores we visited. When the rings were ready, I was taken to the staff room to inspect the GIA certificate and the diamond itself. The craftsmanship was excellent, and the rings matched the original designs perfectly. Anmol even charged less than the initial estimate because the final pieces required less gold, which we thought was very honest.

Thanks to Anmol, we now have a beautifully matched custom ring set, high quality stones and workmanship, and a very fair price. They also have a wide range of other stunning jewellery if you are looking for something more elaborate. I would recommend Anmol to anyone wanting beautiful pieces and genuinely great service.
